classes.CANONICAL_PR_GATE: Executed by .github/workflows/verify.yml on ordinary pull requests.
classes.CANONICAL_PR_GATE_CONTENT_INSPECTED: Canonical gate whose relevant assertions/content were additionally inspected in this PSR-02 run.
classes.SPECIALIZED_EXECUTABLE_NOT_CANONICAL_PR_: Executable security evidence exists but is not credited as a universal PR gate.
classes.DISCOVERED_SPECIALIZED_WORKFLOW: Workflow path exists; existence alone is not proof that it ran or covers its apparent surface.
classes.DISCOVERED_TEST_OR_LAB_ASSET: Executable/test/lab asset path exists; path discovery alone receives no PASS credit.

evidence_policy.rule: Existence is inventory evidence, not security proof. Only executed or specifically inspected gates receive coverage credit.
